fusions.name: Under the Gorget
fusions.desc: Slips a blade into the gap of a wounded enemy's guard, dealing 22 damage. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Flurry From Cover
fusions.desc: Lunges from behind your guard in a flurry of cuts, dealing 26 damage to every enemy in a cone 3 tiles ahead. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Hidden Spikes
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Edge Behind the Plate
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your damage rises by 12%.
